note: vespera-bridge: a request body whose charset= parameter names a charset the JVM does not know is rejected with IllegalArgumentException instead of being sent as UTF-8 under that label; a DIRECT re-dispatch that overflows again releases the stash handle it left instead of holding it until its TTL; GatedRequestInputStream.available() is counted as an in-flight read, so detach() sees it; oversize-policy=throw test asserts the streamed path by stack frames instead of an UnsatisfiedLinkError alone; the streaming executor rejects queued streams after a failed thread start only when no pool thread is left, so a busy worker still serves them; the Windows native-extraction Javadoc states that the ancestors of the base directory are not checked. vespera-bridge-gradle-plugin: bundleNativeLib declares the native/<platform>/ folder mapping as a task input, so a host folder change (glibc to musl) re-bundles the library; a vespera.targets triple must build the arch its key names (a mismatch fails the build instead of bundling a wrong-arch library); the cargoBuild task docs say it is always registered and autoBuildCargo only wires it before bundleNativeLib.
